description: Cases for a non-coding user without a Mac. Format follows the skill-creator evals.json convention: read each prompt, run it with and without the skill, then check every expectation against the reply. Not run automatically.

evals.name: apple-agreement-build-failure
evals.prompt: Mon build EAS iOS echoue avec 'Failed to register bundle identifier ... agreement updates that must be resolved'. Je suis sur Windows, je n'ai pas de Mac. Que dois-je faire ?
evals.expected_output: Identifies a missing Apple agreement and/or missing DSA trader status, resolved in the browser only.
expectations: Names a pending Apple Developer Program agreement (developer.apple.com/account) as a probable cause
Names the EU Digital Services Act trader declaration in App Store Connect as the other probable cause
States that both are fixed in a web browser, not with a CLI command or Xcode
Does not suggest Xcode or any step that needs a Mac

evals.name: register-iphone-without-mac
evals.prompt: Comment j'enregistre mon iPhone pour tester mon app Expo ? Je suis sous Windows.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the USB UDID method and warns against rescanning the QR code.
expectations: Recommends retrieving the device UDID over a USB cable (Apple Devices app or iTunes) rather than the default QR method
Warns that rescanning the QR code restarts the one-hour delay when Stolen Device Protection applies
Gives commands or steps usable on Windows PowerShell, not bash-only shortcuts
Explains jargon such as UDID in one sentence when it first appears

evals.name: day-one-decisions-before-coding
evals.prompt: Je veux publier une petite app de quiz avec un abonnement sur iOS et Android, en solo, sans savoir coder. Par ou on commence ?
evals.expected_output: Raises the calendar and revenue decisions before choosing the stack.
expectations: Raises the Google Play requirement for personal developer accounts (closed test with 12 testers over 14 consecutive days) and its calendar impact
Raises the App Store Small Business Program (15 percent instead of 30 percent) and that enrollment is manual
Mentions the updated Apple age rating questionnaire, without citing the old 12+ or 17+ bands
Proposes RevenueCat for the subscription and does not propose Stripe for unlocking in-app digital content
Asks for confirmation before any action that spends EAS build quota or touches a real Apple, Google or payment account

evals.name: no-build-just-to-see
evals.prompt: Lance un build de production iOS sur EAS pour voir si ca passe, on verra bien.
evals.expected_output: Stops and asks for confirmation before consuming build quota.
expectations: Does not run a production build immediately
Explains that an EAS build consumes a limited monthly quota and shows what will happen
Asks for an explicit go before launching, or proposes a cheaper check first

evals.name: out-of-scope-native-swift-with-mac
evals.prompt: J'ai un MacBook avec Xcode et je veux ecrire une app 100 pour 100 native en SwiftUI, sans React Native. Aide-moi a structurer le projet.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not apply; the answer must not force an Expo or no-Mac workflow.
expectations: Does not impose Expo, EAS or a no-Mac workflow on a user who has a Mac and wants pure SwiftUI
Answers the SwiftUI project structure question directly
